info.title: bConnect Jobs API
info.description: Jobs are the main concept to execute tasks on endpoints managed by baramundi Management Suite (see documentation). Thereby defines a job definition the individual steps to be executed, whereas a job instance describes the actual execution on the endpoints. Job instances are automatically created when a job definition is assigned to one or more endpoints by an administrator or when an end user requests job assignments via the baramundi Kiosk. In order to be available within the baramundi Kiosk, the job definition has to be released by an administrator for the respective user or endpoint.

tags.name: KioskReleases
tags.description: Kiosk releases enable self administered job instance executions within the baramundi Kiosk portal started by logged in devices or users. Kiosk releases always consist of a job definition and an assigned target object which can be an AD object, a logical group or an endpoint.
